jobs.description: Retired by the takeover of the 건물 에너지 lane (root ADR-0564 §6-4, #1662): the Spark producer of gold.parcel_energy, whose script and Spark job are gone; gold_parcel_energy_versions_build builds the lane's table gold.parcel_energy_versions and by_pnu_parcel_energy_bake bakes that. Listed off, never to run again, because a release may not drop a job the running release has enabled (scripts/deploy/foundation-release.sh activation); the entry goes in a later change, once a release that lists it off is live.
jobs.memory_measured: no memory peak logged 2026-10-18..11-08 (no cap, so no memory accounting); sized as the script foundation-gold-panel-rebuild.service runs (307M measured, 57 runs); Spark runs in its own capped container; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

per_run_cap.unmeasured_reason: Not enabled and never to run again: the lane was taken over (root ADR-0564 §6-4, #1662), so no run of it is left to measure.

jobs.disabled_reason: Off for good: the lane was taken over on 2026-11-23 (root ADR-0564 §6-4, #1662) and gold_parcel_energy_versions_build is its producer. Nothing turns it on; the entry is deleted once a release that lists it off is live (the release activation refuses a candidate that drops an enabled job).

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: 건물 에너지(전기·가스) 12 개월 kind Gold as a table of appended row versions (root ADR-0398, ADR-0564 §6; scripts/ops/gold-versions-build.sh parcel-energy → publisher build-parcel-energy-versions): gold.parcel_energy_versions from the parcel's current monthly electricity and gas use (silver.building_energy_monthly_*), computed by DuckDB inside the publisher and appended as the keys whose digest changed (a removal marker for a key that left), each commit one version_seq. The lane's table since its takeover (the Spark gold_parcel_energy_rebuild and gold.parcel_energy's writes ended with it; takeover_equal was equal in 시도 41 on run 20261123T005744Z): it reads every input at its head. Nothing to do when its inputs, the served parcel edition and its code are the base commit's. A change of the code change table, the served edition or the code rebuilds every PNU; otherwise only the PNUs whose rows or served parcels changed. by_pnu_parcel_energy_bake bakes its commits.
jobs.memory_measured: its own: run 20261123T005744Z of foundation-gold-versions@parcel-energy (2026-11-23 00:57-01:02Z, every served parcel's 10,917,379 usage rows in 17 시도, 1,449,777 rows committed in 275 s), the publisher's cgroup memory peak in its run log 3,225,636,864 bytes
jobs.memory_headroom_why: The peak follows the cap, not the work: the publisher gives DuckDB three fifths of what the unit has left under MemoryHigh (parcel_nearby_versions_build MEMORY_SHARE), so a larger memory_max would only raise the peak. The run fit: no timeout, under MemoryMax

first_run.estimated_from: computed, not measured: the first shadow build holds every key, so it reads the served parcel edition's PNUs (about 40 million) and the kind's current rows and folds them in one statement, as gold_parcel_register_masters_versions_build does; about 900 s, inside the 60-minute limit. Later runs rebuild the changed PNUs only.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: Reflect each new commit of gold.parcel_energy_versions (the own-producer 건물 에너지 kind, root ADR-0398) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-energy), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9): a change set decides a create-only patch, a reflect-only manifest or a full new generation, exactly as the panel bake does per lane. Its own job, as every own-producer kind's (root ADR-0303 §2). Nothing to do until the operator's first pack-only publish of the lane (root ADR-0190). Started when gold_parcel_energy_versions_build commits; the first bake after the takeover is a full generation with a content check against the served one (root ADR-0564 §6-5), and at 10:55 as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two slots and MemoryMax=5G, the ownership bake's bound, for the same reason: never beside both the panel bake and another own-producer bake (root ADR-0138).

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the lane's own bakes measured in its cut-over's bake step (by-pnu-pack-operator.sh parcel-energy bake, the same by-pnu-serving-bake.sh): 146 s, 275 s and 120 s on 2026-11-09 for 1,446,147 documents; the first scheduled bake after the publish may cut a whole generation (no reads.jsonl yet, root ADR-0468 §4), so 900 s, inside the 6,210 s share of the 115-minute limit

assets.title: 필지 건물 에너지 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 그 지번의 최근 12개월 전기(kWh)·가스 사용량(달마다 행 합계와 행 수)을 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0398). 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-energy)이 자기 생산자를 이름 짓고, 두 월별 에너지 Silver 에서 만든다. 서빙 필지판의 PNU만, 바뀐 필지만 다시 계산한다. 넘겨받기(루트 ADR-0564 §6-4) 뒤로는 쓰지 않고 남긴다(쌓기만 한다): 레인은 gold.parcel_energy_versions 를 굽는다.

assets.title: 필지 건물 에너지 by-PNU 표(판을 쌓는 표)
assets.description: 루트 ADR-0398 의 건물 에너지(전기·가스) 12 개월 by-PNU 표를 판을 쌓는 표로(루트 ADR-0564 §1·§2): gold.parcel_energy 의 칸에 version_seq·row_state 를 더해 바뀐 PNU 의 행만 덧붙인다. 현재 행은 PNU 마다 version_seq 가 가장 큰 행이고 row_state 가 removed 면 그 PNU 는 없다. 발행기 안의 DuckDB 가 계산하고 발행기가 추가 커밋으로 붙인다. 레인이 굽는 표다(넘겨받기, 루트 ADR-0564 §6-4): 입력의 머리로 짓는다.

assets.title: 필지 건물 에너지 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_energy_versions 의 현재 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/energy/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0398). 첫 발행은 운영자의 묶음 전용 관문을 거친다.

dependencies.description: 전기 사용량 행을 서빙 법정동 코드로 다시 매겨 필지·월마다 더한다(DuckDB, 루트 ADR-0398). 행이 바뀐 PNU 만 다시 짓는다.
가스 사용량 행을 서빙 법정동 코드로 다시 매겨 필지·월마다 더한다(DuckDB, 루트 ADR-0398). 행이 바뀐 PNU 만 다시 짓는다.
서빙 필지판의 PNU 가 문서의 전체 집합이다(루트 ADR-0292). 들고 난 필지만 다시 짓는다.
재편으로 바뀐 코드의 행을 서빙 코드로 읽는다(루트 ADR-0329 §3). 이 표가 바뀌면 모든 PNU 를 다시 짓는다.
레인의 굽기가 이 표의 현재 행을 읽는다(넘겨받기, 루트 ADR-0564 §6-4). 넘겨받은 뒤 첫 굽기는 서빙 세대와 내용을 견주는 전량 세대다(§6-5).
